_comment: Skin registry. The in-app picker is built from this file, so adding a skin means dropping a folder next to this one and adding an entry here. See 'Making your own skin' in the README. Each id must match its folder name, which must contain layout.html and style.css.

skins.name: Modern
skins.blurb: Dual sticks, D-pad, ABXY, four shoulder buttons

skins.name: Symbols
skins.blurb: Dual sticks with shape face buttons

skins.name: Classic
skins.blurb: D-pad and four face buttons, no sticks

skins.name: Arcade
skins.blurb: Fight-stick: one stick, six big buttons
